NYC's De Blasio Seeks to Change Admissions Standards for City's Elite Schools - "he wants to end... policy that restricts admission... to students who score highest on a standardized test."

This is because standardized testing is not the panacea people believe. Test prep schools and such are proof that this approach is ineffective. In practice those with access and resources to study to the test will perform better. This is an inherent problem in all standardized testing.

The question being asked is "do we want our top public schools to educate the entire population or do we want them to serve as a purchasable gateway to elite higher education institutions?"

The argument that this is racist is itself racist, of course. The suggestion that there is meritocracy that creates the ethnic breakdown we find in these schools is entirely racist. They then resort to claiming it is "cultural" which is only slightly better. No, it's neither, it's simply evidence of a flawed admission system. Credit to various groups for working it in their favor but it's still flawed. Nobody is asking for racial quota percentages but those who suggest this system works are also suggesting that all of the black and hispanic students in NYC are idiots. This is of course not true - it does appear that they are lacking opportunity available to Asian students. The extracurricular approach and high value placed on educational attainment is what achieves these admissions for the Asian students by and large - but within those groups you'll find severe doubt about whether this is worth it or not.

Ultimately finding a way to admit Asian and other students without rigorous extra-hour studying and a tunnel-vision focus on test prep benefits all students, probably the overworked Asian kids the most.

Moronic Monday question: If whoaverse is using reddit's source code, why does it behave differently in so many little ways compared to Reddit?
The only part of the reddit code used is the html/css. The backend is re-written.

Hi. Whoaverse is not using reddits source code. Whoaverse has been completely written from scratch in a completely different language (reddit is mostly Python, whoaverse is C#). The only thing we use from reddit so far (not for long though) is the design (cascading stylesheet) which defines visual aspect of the site like how big fonts will be, colors etc. But everything back-end is written by me apart from third party plugins like mardkdowndeep (markdown syntax processor), Twitter Bootstrap and jQuery.
